safety_contract.decision: product RUN/KILL and unattended watchdog architecture

rail.brownout_threshold: TPS3808G33 factory threshold; SENSE tied to AON_SAFE_3V3

physical_inputs.run_kill: exact maintained C&K JS102011SCQN: COMMON is safety ground, THROW_A is RUN_LOOP_RAW and THROW_B is POWER_COMMAND_OFF_N. RUN selects the filtered AON run loop; KILL grounds the pack shutdown command. Break-before-make travel necessarily removes RUN before asserting source shutdown
physical_inputs.recovery: a latched fault cannot be cleared by software, reset, USB, I2C or a held switch. The operator must move RUN to KILL and back to RUN after every monitored condition is safe
physical_inputs.esd_and_connector: one dedicated TPD4E05U06DQAR protects RUN_LOOP_RAW with both ground pads returned to safety ground; exact side access, legend, travel, sealing and switch-state truth remain mechanical HIL

latch_logic.preset: FAULT_ASSERT_N is an active-low wired fault plane driven by KILL, TPS3435 WDO_N and the safety-controller fault request; any one acts asynchronously
latch_logic.clear: POR_N clears the latch only during a genuine AON restart; normal recovery clocks fixed D=0 only on a fresh conditioned KILL-to-RUN edge after the safety controller reports all release conditions safe
latch_logic.rearm: the only re-arm action is physical KILL-to-RUN. Firmware can refuse the edge but can never synthesize or bypass it; automatic restart is forbidden

reset_fanout.driver: SN74LVC1G06DCKR AON-powered open-drain inverter with Ioff; RUN_PERMIT high actively holds RF_RESET_KILL_GATE low, while KILL, a latched fault or AON loss releases it

watchdog.controller: a second exact MSPM0C1106SDGS20R is dedicated to the AON safety domain at SYS-I2C address 0x2B; it does not share the pack-admission firmware image or supply dependency
watchdog.independent_timer: exact TPS3435CAKAGDDFR uses its 1.6-s timeout with zero startup delay; WDO_N is active-low open-drain and presets FAULT_KILL without MCU, bus or UI participation
watchdog.leases: S3 must provide a bounded system heartbeat and an explicit short-lived lease for the currently active signal group. Missing/early/late heartbeat, expired TX lease, actual TX without a matching lease, stuck evidence or unreadable evidence mask requests FAULT_KILL

The 2S pair is 28.8Wh nominal and retains the 6.0-8.4V product window. Only manufacturer or authorized regional-kit supply with exact assembly transport/safety evidence is admitted; missing UN38.3 test-summary identity, counterfeit evidence, mixed MPN/lot/age/SOC or failed specimen HIL remains disconnected
power_contract.battery_thermal_coupling: PACK_NTC0 and PACK_NTC1 each use a dedicated electrically insulated compliant contact through an open holder window to the middle third of their own cell can. The independent BQ25798 TS NTC uses one of two indexed physical tongue locations and is populated on the thermally worst slot after placement analysis. Open/short/lifted contact blocks admission or charge; compression, insulation, response time and replacement-cycle HIL remain mandatory
power_contract.battery_manager: MAX17320G20+T 2S gauge/protector plus independently recoverable MSPM0C1106SDGS20R admission controller; G20 is I2C without SHA-256; blank/wrong gauge NVM or reset/watchdog MCU remains fail-closed
power_contract.battery_recovery_policy: base product refuses any cell below the qualified admission floor; MAX17320 zero-volt charge and linear prequal are disabled; any research recovery uses a separate isolated Controlled-Zone fixture
power_contract.power_command_profile: C&K JS102011SCQN is the single maintained SPDT low-current RUN/KILL control. KILL grounds pack-admission PA24/A3 and requests orderly shutdown followed by protected-pack release; RUN grounds the separate AON RUN_LOOP_RAW input and supplies the only physical re-arm edge. Break-before-make travel removes RUN before asserting source shutdown. The switch never carries cell, SYS, charge or load current; KILL preserves USB charging and independent service recovery but no automatic application restart is allowed.
power_contract.manager_power_path: one active CSD87313DMST common-drain package provides the fully-switching CHG/DIS pair required by MAX17320; two 0451005.MRL slot fuses, WSL25125L000FEA 5mOhm shunt and two B57332V5103F360 cell NTCs are exact first targets
power_contract.manager_supply: MAX17320 AOLDO and isolated fixture enter BAV70LT1G; admitted system 3V3 enters BAT54-7-F and wins by lower drop. One 2N7002DW-7-F asserts ALRT hold during MCU reset; a second exact dual 2N7002DW-7-F translates push-pull PFAIL into admission-domain active-low status and turns PA23 into a passive-drain SYS_INT_N request. Exact IN/CP/REG/AOLDO, 2S CELL1/BATTS, PCKP, CHG/DIS-gate, local-I2C and MSPM0 VDD/NRST support is machine-instantiated; source handover and current remain HIL gates
power_contract.manager_support_profile: MAX17320 IN uses ERJ-P08F10R0V from fused stack positive and C1005X7R1H104K050BB to local ground; CP uses GRM188R71E474KA12D to IN. AOLDO, REG3 and REG2 each use an independent GRM188R71E474KA12D. The exact 2S Figure-24 mapping uses ERJ-P08F49R9V at CELL1 and BATTS, shorts CELL1/CELL2/CELL3 into the midpoint sense node, retains independent C1005X7R1H104K050BB CELL1-to-GND and BATTS-to-CELL3 filters, grounds unused TH3/TH4, and Kelvin-routes CSP/CSN to the force-connected WSL25125L000FEA shunt. PCKP uses 1 kOhm from protected pack positive; CHG and DIS each retain 100 nF gate-to-source. Private SCL/SDA and ALRT each have exact external pull-ups. MSPM0 VDD uses 10 uF plus 100 nF and NRST uses 47 kOhm plus 10 nF with a test point. Paper electrical closure does not replace layout, lot or HIL proof
power_contract.pack_system_i2c_target: MSPM0C1106 uses fixed firmware-defined 7-bit address 0x2A on SYS_I2C; its private bit-banged MAX17320 bus is electrically separate
power_contract.rail_tree: BQ25798 SYS feeds independent fixed AON_RAW_3V3, MAIN_RAW_3V3, VVOICE_RAW_4V and 5V_EXT_RAW converters; independent post-buck protection creates AON_SAFE_3V3, 3V3_MAIN, VVOICE_4V and protected 5V_EXT, so a shorted converter high-side switch is not a direct SYS-to-load path
power_contract.aon_rail: TPS629203DRLR plus WPN201612H2R2MT generates AON_RAW_3V3 using 2.5MHz auto-PFM/PWM; TPS25961DRVR then creates AON_SAFE_3V3 at >=15mA continuous and >=30mA transient. This includes the TPS25751 VIN_3V3 maximum active load, safety logic and three simultaneously active AD8314 nRF detectors with worst-case current margin, while MAX17320 AOLDO is not used as the product safety supply
power_contract.application_rails: three independent TPS564252DRLR channels generate raw 3.3/4.0/5.0-V rails. TPS25974LRPWR post-protection creates 3V3_MAIN >=2.5A continuous/3.0A step and VVOICE_4V >=1.25A continuous/1.5A transient; the existing reverse-blocking TPS259470LRPWR creates 5V_EXT >=1.25A continuous with a bounded 2.0A post-start transient
power_contract.rail_inductors: MWSA0503S-3R3MT is the exact first target for 3V3_MAIN and VVOICE_4V; MWSA0503S-4R7MT is the exact first target for 5V_EXT
power_contract.converter_passive_profile: TPS629203 uses open FB/VSET for fixed 3.3V, RC0402FR-0742K2L on MODE/S-CONF for 2.5MHz auto-PFM/PWM AEE without discharge, one CGA5L1X7R1E475K160AC input capacitor and one GRM31CR71A226KE15L output capacitor. Each TPS564252 uses one GRM32ER71E226KE15L plus one C1005X7R1H104K050BB at VIN, two independent GRM32ER71E226KE15L output capacitors and one C0402C330J5GACTU feed-forward capacitor. Fixed 1% dividers are 45.3k/10k for nominal 3.318V main, 68k/12k for 4.000V voice and 220k/30k for 5.000V external
power_contract.quiet_switches: independent TPS22919DCKR instances gate the nRF group, CC1101, microSD, ES8311 and Si4732 branches with reset-off ON pulls and qualified QOD discharge
power_contract.switched_pg_qualification: separate MMBT3904-7-F stages qualify protected voice eFuse PG and protected accessory converter/eFuse evidence with their RUN_PERMIT-qualified EN requests; only EN high plus PG low at the protected rail may pull POWER_FAULT_N low, so a normally disabled rail is not a fault. Raw main and voice converter PG contacts remain diagnostic test points and cannot falsely certify the load side of a tripped post-buck eFuse
power_contract.converter_control_passive_profile: Ten physical resistor positions close converter control after DEC-0080. TPS629203 EN is tied directly to admitted SYS and its PG has one RC0402FR-0747KL pull-up to AON_SAFE_3V3. TPS564252 optional EN defaults use one RC0402FR-0710KL for voice and accessory; the main EN fail-low is RC0402FR-07100KL so the 10-kOhm open-drain POR pull-up releases it to about 3.0V rather than a marginal 1.65V. POWER_FAULT_N has one RC0402FR-0710KL pull-up; voice and accessory PG each have their own RC0402FR-0710KL pull-up. Each MMBT3904 qualifier base uses one RC0402FR-0768KL series resistor
power_contract.source_sequence_profile: No separate programmable source-admission sequencer exists. Valid battery admission or protected USB power creates BQ25798 SYS; SYS starts TPS629203 in hardware. Its pulled-up AON_PG_N directly drives TPS3808G33 MR_N. The supervisor then requires both its 3.07-V SENSE threshold and AON PG, applies the exact CT delay, and releases open-drain POR_N. One exact RC0402FR-0710KL pulls POR_N to AON_SAFE_3V3 and the existing RC0402FR-07100KL pulls MAIN_3V3_EN low, producing about 3.0V at release and forcing main off on AON PG/SENSE loss without firmware
power_contract.internal_rail_protection_profile: TPS25961DRVR lies between AON_RAW_3V3 and AON_SAFE_3V3 with RC0402FR-07240KL nominal 0.208-A current limit, RC0402FR-07196KL/RC0402FR-07100KL 3.505-3.809-V OVLO corner window, one local 100-nF input capacitor and one 10-uF protected output capacitor. Main and voice each use latch-off circuit-breaker TPS25974LRPWR, 4.7-nF controlled rise, 120-pF approximately 0.09-ms transient blanking and protected-rail PG. Main uses a 1.65-kOhm 3.2-3.715-A threshold, precision 191/100-kOhm 3.438-3.578-V OVLO window and 45.3/30-kOhm PG divider. Voice uses a 3.32-kOhm 1.55-1.905-A threshold, 270/100-kOhm 4.314-4.610-V OVLO window and 68/33-kOhm PG divider. Every EN/UVLO is tied to its own sub-5-V raw rail; firmware cannot bypass OVLO, overcurrent, short or thermal shutdown

power_contract.diagnostic_load_profile: Two parallel CRM2512-FX-20R0ELF pulse-rated 20-ohm/2-W resistors form an exact 10-ohm 4-W load ahead of a DMN2056U-7 low-side switch across the fused 2S stack. PA22 emits only a rising edge into non-retriggerable TPUL2G223BQBR channel 1; exact 169-kOhm/220-nF C0G timing gives about 34.4 ms typical and a conservative 28.7-40.7 ms paper range, with production accepting only 25-50 ms. At the end of every channel-1 pulse, its falling Q edge starts channel 2. Exact 620-kOhm/1-uF timing holds complementary 2Q low for a paper minimum of 350 ms and asynchronously clears channel 1, so a stuck or hostile MCU can produce at most one bounded pulse per refractory interval. The two load resistors remain below their combined hot derated continuous rating even under that hardware-only worst case; firmware imposes a longer HIL-derived operational cooldown
power_contract.admission_adc_profile: MSPM0 internal 1.4-V reference measures midpoint on PA25/ADC0_2 through 2x220-kOhm over 169-kOhm plus 10-nF and full stack on PA26/ADC0_1 through 5x220-kOhm over 169-kOhm plus 10-nF. At 4.3/8.6-V fault-screen maxima and 1% resistor corners, ADC inputs remain below 1.21/1.17 V; all three safety-zone sensors use real ADC contacts PA16/ADC0_14, PA26/ADC0_1 and PA27/ADC0_0
power_contract.charger_passive_profile: BQ25798 is physically strapped for 2S at 750kHz by RC0402FR-078K2L and MWSA0503S-2R2MT. Twelve independent GRM31CR71E106MA12L bulk capacitors, three C1005X7R1H104K050BB HF capacitors, two GRM155R71E473KA88D bootstrap capacitors, one CGA5L1X7R1E475K160AC REGN capacitor and one C0402C102K5RACTU SDRV capacitor implement the no-ship-FET/no-backup path. A 44.2k/100k ILIM divider bounds the physical input target to about 2.71-3.29A over REGN and resistor corners; negotiated IINDPM is always the lower limit. B57332V5103F360 plus 5.23k/30.1k provides a direct non-ignored charger TS gate; shared local-bus SCL/SDA use exact 2.2-kOhm TPS-LDO pull-ups, INT uses 10 kOhm, and reset-high CE pulls to REGN while TPS GPIO1 acts as an open-drain enable
power_contract.pd_support_profile: TPS25751D hardware SafeMode straps ADCIN1 high and ADCIN2 low for target address 0x20. Raw USB VBUS feeds both VBUS and VBUS_IN; PP5V is grounded for sink-only operation. VIN_3V3 uses AON_SAFE_3V3 after autonomous dead-battery startup. Exact 10-uF VIN/LDO capacitors, 4.7-uF VBUS, four 22-uF PPHV capacitors, 220-pF C0G per protected CC, EEPROM bypass/WP pull-up, 2.2-kOhm local and host I2C pull-ups and a 10-kOhm host IRQ pull-up complete the paper circuit. EEPROM address straps are low; GPIO0 is open-drain and may sink WP only in an authorized signed-update window; every unused TPS GPIO is grounded
power_contract.product_usb_profile: JAE DX07S016JA1R1500 terminates the product port. A single TI TPD4S201RUKR protects connector-side CC1/CC2 and repurposes its two explicitly USB2-capable SBU channels for D+/D-, adding 28-V short-to-VBUS and IEC ESD isolation before TPS25751D and S3. Two exact 22-Ohm series resistors at S3 follow the Espressif initial USB Full-Speed RC recommendation; two 0402 shunt-capacitor positions are reserved DNP and therefore are not BOM instances until measured tuning requires them. RPD_G1/G2 loop to connector-side CC for dead-battery attach. VPWR uses TPS LDO_3V3 with an exact 1-uF capacitor; VBIAS uses an exact 100-nF/100-V capacitor. FLT has a 10-kOhm LDO_3V3 pull-up and protected test point without consuming a GPIO. Two exact 220-pF C0G CC shunts replace 330 pF so TPS 120-pF input plus 40-120-pF protector and capacitor tolerance remain at 369-471 pF before route parasitics, leaving 129 pF to the USB-PD 600-pF ceiling. SBU and Alt Mode are unsupported; VBUS remains on the existing TVS2200/TPS sink-only path
power_contract.external_protection: TPS259470LRPWR follows the 5V converter and provides always-on reverse blocking, latch-off thermal-fault behavior and open-drain fault evidence. RC0402FR-072K21L sets a nominal 1.509A current limit that applies immediately at startup; GRM155R71H472KA01D limits the controlled startup slew. GRM188R71E224KA88D permits only a bounded post-start 2A transient; it does not defer startup current limiting. The exact OVLO divider, local capacitors and passive output bleeder complete the accepted paper profile
